messages:
lucas (PM): quick sync � we're planning retirements for three legacy entries in the catalog next month. goal: zero customer surprises and an automatic compatibility shim for common embed+chat contracts. what are the minimal ops + product guards?
deepa (Data): data reqs: need canonical prompt/response examples for each model to validate parity. suggest 2k examples per model, weighted by token length and intent type.
marco (SRE): ops guard list: canary cohorts, realtime metric diffs, and a throttled rollback window. propose these thresholds: error_rate delta >0.5% OR embed_cos_sim drop >0.06 -> rollback. also want circuit-breaker that stops canary after 15m of sustained error spike.
elaine (Legal): flag: customers under specific contracts need 30d notice. CS must clear the customer list before we kick off. also need logs retention for 6 months for audits.
maria (CS): can do customer outreach. ask: can customers opt into a compatibility shim that translates old output schema? helps reduce lift on their side.
lucas (PM): yes, compatibility shim is our plan: output adapter that maintains legacy field names + new enriched fields under a separate key. vis: legacy_out and modern_out.
marco (SRE): rough config prototype for rollout and shim toggle:
```
retire_plan: {
  models: ["legacy-embed-1","legacy-chat-3","legacy-rank-2"],
  canary: {cohorts: ["internal","beta-customers"], duration: "2h", traffic: "1%"},
  ramp: [5,20,50,100],
  rollback_triggers: ["error_rate_gt_0.5pct_15m","embed_cos_drop_gt_0.06_30m"],
  shim: {enabled: true, translation_map: "s3://catalog/shims/v1/"}
}
```
deepa (Data): evaluation pipeline: run pairwise A/B on the canonical examples, compute length-normalized logprob delta, response-token-distribution shift, and embedding cosine. badge if embed_cosine_mean > 0.95 and logprob_delta within -0.08..+0.05.
elaine (Legal): ensure opt-in UX stores consent record (user, timestamp, model_version) and exportable CSV.
maria (CS): for customers who want extended runway, can we support per-tenant pin TTL? e.g., allow customer to keep legacy pinned for 60d.
lucas (PM): yes — we should support pin TTLs per tenant. need UI + API surface. Sophie (not here) wanted a one-click revert; we'll mirror that as `Unpin` in console.
marco (SRE): automation: ops-bot will run checks and can auto-rollback but require manual approval before full ramp beyond 50%. assign playbook to @marco.
ops-bot: scheduled canary start for legacy-embed-1 -> beta-customers at 2026-04-07T09:00:00Z. monitors: error_rate, p95_latency, embed_cosine_mean.
lucas (PM): action items recap: (1) Data to produce canonical examples and evaluation thresholds (deepa), (2) SRE to wire rollout + rollback automation and circuit-breaker (marco), (3) CS to compile contract-bound customers and opt-in flow (maria), (4) Legal to confirm consent storage and notice language (elaine), (5) PM to draft UI copy + pin TTL UX. sync Thurs 11am.
